#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class NumberTheory {
public:
    static void ASSERT(bool assertion) {
        if (!assertion) throw runtime_error("Assertion failed");
    }

    template<typename M>
    class Modulus {
    public:
        IntStack factorial;
        IntStack invFactorial;

        Modulus() : factorial(8), invFactorial(8) {
            factorial.push(1);
            invFactorial.push(1);
        }

        virtual long long modulus() const = 0;

        long long fact(int n) {
            while (factorial.size() <= n) {
                factorial.push((int)mult(factorial.get(factorial.size() - 1), factorial.size()));
            }
            return factorial.get(n);
        }

        long long fInv(int n) {
            int lastKnown = invFactorial.size() - 1;
            if (lastKnown < n) {
                int len = n - lastKnown;
                vector<long long> fInv(len);
                fInv[0] = inv(fact(n));
                for (int i = 1; i < len; i++) {
                    fInv[i] = mult(fInv[i - 1], n - i + 1);
                }
                for (int i = len - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                    invFactorial.push((int)fInv[i]);
                }
            }
            return invFactorial.get(n);
        }

        long long ncr(int n, int r) {
            ASSERT(n >= 0);
            if (r < 0 || n < r) return 0;
            return mult(fact(n), mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
        }

        long long smallInv(int n) {
            return mult(fInv(n), fact(n - 1));
        }

        long long normalize(long long x) const {
            x %= modulus();
            if (x < 0) x += modulus();
            return x;
        }

        long long add(long long a, long long b) const {
            long long v = a + b;
            return v < modulus() ? v : v - modulus();
        }

        long long subtract(long long a, long long b) const {
            long long v = a - b;
            return v < 0 ? v + modulus() : v;
        }

        long long mult(long long a, long long b) const {
            return (a * b) % modulus();
        }

        long long mult(initializer_list<long long> args) const {
            long long r = 1;
            for (long long x : args) r = mult(r, x);
            return r;
        }

        long long inv(long long value) {
            long long g = modulus(), x = 0, y = 1;
            for (long long r = value; r != 0; ) {
                long long q = g / r;
                g %= r;
                swap(g, r);
                long long temp = x - q * y;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }
            ASSERT(g == 1);
            ASSERT(y == modulus() || y == -modulus());
            return normalize(x);
        }
    };

    class Mod998 : public Modulus<Mod998> {
    public:
        long long modulus() const override { return 998244353; }
    };
};

class IntStack {
public:
    vector<int> array;

    IntStack() : array(8) {}
    IntStack(int capacity) : array(capacity) {}

    int size() const { return array.size(); }
    int get(int i) const { return array[i]; }

    void push(int item) {
        array.push_back(item);
    }
};

class InputReader {
public:
    BufferedReader reader;
    StringTokenizer tokenizer;

    InputReader(istream& stream) : reader(stream), tokenizer("") {}

    string next() {
        while (!tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
            string line;
            if (!getline(reader, line)) throw runtime_error("Input error");
            tokenizer = StringTokenizer(line);
        }
        return tokenizer.nextToken();
    }

    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
};

class HZSShufflesCards {
public:
    NumberTheory::Mod998 mod;
    int n, m;

    void solve(InputReader& in, PrintWriter& out) {
        n = in.nextInt();
        m = in.nextInt();

        mod.fInv(n + m);

        long long phaseSize = 1;
        long long p = 1;
        for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
            p = mod.mult(p, n - i, mod.smallInv(n + m - i));
            phaseSize = mod.add(phaseSize, p);
        }

        long long answer = 0;
        for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
            long long term = mod.mult({mod.ncr(n, k), (long long)(m + k), mod.smallInv(k), phaseSize});
            if (k % 2 == 1)
                answer = mod.add(answer, term);
            else
                answer = mod.subtract(answer, term);
        }

        out.println(answer);
    }
};

class PrintWriter {
public:
    PrintWriter() {}
    void println(long long x) { cout << x << '\n'; }
    void close() {}
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    InputReader in(cin);
    PrintWriter out;
    HZSShufflesCards solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, out);
    out.close();

    return 0;
}
